summary: Triple-dword copy (__thiscall): when source a2 is non-null, copies three consecutive dwords from a2 into the destination struct at byte offsets 0xC, 0x10 and 0x14 (elements [3],[4],[5] of the dword view of this). Returns the third source dword a2[2], or a2 itself when the source is null. Structural twin of TripleFieldSetter (0040acc6) per the cluster prelabel.

operations.description: Guard on a2: when the source pointer is null the copy is skipped and a2 is returned as-is.
Copy source dword 0 into destination byte offset 0xC (this + 3).
Copy source dword 1 into destination byte offset 0x10 (v3[1]).
Copy source dword 2 into destination byte offset 0x14 (v3[2]) and keep it as the return value.
Return the third copied dword a2[2] (as a pointer-sized value), or a2 when the source was null.

Invoked by sub_457000 (0x00457000), sub_4572B0 (0x004572B0), F_2DTransformStructCopy (0x00457B60), sub_4585E0 (0x004585E0), SuspensionWheelForceCalculation (0x00459070) and sub_459330 (0x00459330) to seed a three-component destination field.

unresolved: Meaning of the copied three-dword value (possibly a 3D vector stored at +0xC) depends on the owning struct, which is unknown here
